messages:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: 1. HorizonCorp (enterprise, VPC, dedicated pool hzn-ded-07) is reporting missing traces and partial metric visibility. High P95 gen latency observed. Pager escalated to SREs and ProdOps. Please acknowledge and join.

raj_engineer: ack. joining. seeing alerts: p95 latency +200% for tenant=horizoncorp, error-rate spike ~3%.

maya_prodops: /me looking at observability — traces for HorizonCorp show as 'not found' from trace-aggregator. Metrics for per-tenant request counts are present but missing spans. Logs for the pool exist but logs are in a customer-encrypted bucket (horizoncorp-logs-us-east) - we don't have access due to KMS key policy.

jordan_ops: what changed in the last deploy to hzn-ded-07? any network plugins, trace-forwarder config?

raj_engineer: last infra change was a route-table update pushed 03:10 UTC to avoid IP exhaustion. I see ephemeral route rule 10.200.0.0/16 -> nat-gw removed and replaced; might have unintentionally blocked the trace-forwarder -> central-collector path.

maya_prodops: that would explain no egress to the collector. no spans, only local logs. Customer-facing generators still serve, but we lose distributed traces so debugging is hard.

emma_support: customer impact summary for comms: HorizonCorp experiencing slow responses and partial debug info missing. Affects prod and staging dedicated pools. Estimated affected tenants: HorizonCorp only (we've isolated by tenant id).

raj_engineer: quick mitigation options:
1) re-add route to allow trace-forwarder egress (need network oncall)
2) flip trace proxy to run inside the dedicated pool and batch-forward via cluster-internal path (requires a K8s env change)
3) request temporary access to customer KMS bucket to pull logs (legal/ops + customer approval)

jordan_ops: network oncall pinged (cc @leo_oncall). leo — can you confirm route-table rollback or temporary route?

leo_oncall: on it. 2-min check. I can revert the route change as a fast rollback. Will coordinate with infra-change review to avoid flapping.

incident_bot: INCIDENT NOTE: Handoff required if unresolved in 30m. Next oncall: leo_oncall.

maya_prodops: while net is looked at, we can enable a local trace-proxy as a temporary workaround. Config patch below — will only affect hzn-ded-07 and is reversible. Need one approver from ProdOps + infra.

raj_engineer: paste: ```yaml
# deploy patch for temporary proxy
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: trace-proxy
  namespace: hzn-ded
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: trace-proxy
        image: redwood/trace-proxy:canary-2026-03
        env:
        - name: ENABLE_PROXY
          value: "true"
        - name: TARGET_COLLECTOR
          value: "internal-collector.svc.cluster.local:4317"
```

maya_prodops: command to apply: `kubectl apply -f trace-proxy-temp.yml --context=hzn-ded-07`  — will create local egress path to internal collector.

emma_support: customer comms draft: "We've identified reduced observability for your requests and are deploying a temporary proxy to restore traces while we validate network changes. No data deletion. We will update within 60 minutes." ok to send once we have rollback plan?

leo_oncall: network rollback completed at 03:26 UTC — I restored the previous route rule and verified trace-forwarder egress from hzn-ded-07 to central collector. Traces started appearing (partial), latency dropping.

raj_engineer: confirmed traces returning. making the proxy optional: plan is to wait 5m then rollback the proxy if no regression. If route holds, we remove the proxy to avoid duplicating spans.

maya_prodops: quick caveat — even though traces resumed, we still cannot access the customer's encrypted log bucket from console due to key policy. for deep debugging we need customer to add a principals entry for redwood-observability@horizoncorp or share a signed grant. I've DM'ed the AE to request the grant.

emma_support: AE replied: customer approves a one-time access grant for support engineers for 2 hours. Legal notified.

raj_engineer: added steps to run after we get grant: 
- fetch logs: `aws s3 cp s3://horizoncorp-logs-us-east/2026-03-15/ . --profile support-temp`
- check spans correlated to request ids prefixed `hc-`

incident_bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: #INC-4827 created; severity P1 -> P2 after route rollback and partial trace restore.

jordan_ops: handoff notes for next oncall (leo_oncall): monitor p95 for horizoncorp for 1 hour, confirm logs pulled and KMS grant removed after session, verify no further route changes pushed to hzn-ded-07.

leo_oncall: acked. I'll monitor and follow up. leaving this thread to oncall handoff. :wave: If anything spikes again, re-pager.

emma_support: customer update sent at 03:45 UTC: "Temp proxy deployed and network routes restored. We are seeing traces return and are pulling logs under a one-time grant. We'll follow up with a full postmortem."

raj_engineer: notes for postmortem: root cause = route-table change removed egress path for trace-forwarder; secondary issue = KMS policy prevented direct log access causing slower investigation. Remediation: add preflight check to infra change job to validate observability egress; add monitoring alert for 'tenant trace-gap' that fires when spans missing for > 2m while request metrics present.

incident_bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (conditionally): degraded -> mitigated. Postmortem owner assigned: raj_engineer.

emma_support: closing customer loop and filing comms + RCA.

leo_oncall: leaving note: will escalate to infra-policy team to enforce trace-egress pre-flight.

incident_bot: Thread archived.
